summary: ansible.builtin.tree is used by ad hoc -t/--tree to write a JSON file of events per host to a directory; it is deprecated and removed in 2.23.
questions: How do I save ad hoc results to a file per host?

answer_card.title: tree callback (deprecated)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.tree` backs the ad hoc `-t` / `--tree` option, writing a JSON dump of events to one file per host in the given directory. It is **deprecated** for instability and **removed in 2.23**.
